title: Display resolved addresses in Statistics > Endpoints dialog
description:
If the option `Resolve network (IP) addresses` is selected,
display the resolved host name in a separate column.

notes.body: We already have a "Name resolution" setting. Can this be used instead of adding a new column?

Yes, you are right. I overlooked this setting.

Maybe the new column is useful for display or export, to have both the IP and the host name...

If adding a new column it must resolve all resolvable addresses, not only IPv4 and IPv6.
But I think you should start look at using the existing setting.

I suggest that if the checkbox is ticked, a new column is displayed next to the address and next to the port with the resolved data. The new columns are hidden when the checkbox is unchecked.

The original columns with address and port always show the unresolved data.
